full.description: This is a post-mortem X-ray angiogram of a whole heart. The image clearly visualizes the coronary arterial vasculature, including the major coronary branches spreading across the heart muscle. Extensive lesions within the coronary arteries are visible, which is indicative of significant coronary atherosclerosis. This imaging technique is useful for post-mortem evaluation of vascular occlusion and heart disease.
